entries.english: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.\nWith its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed\nthat grows between rocks.

entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: A rare Pokémon discovered during a\ndeep-sea exploration. It has not\nchanged in over 100 million years.
entries.portuguese: Pokémon raro descoberto numa\nexpedição submarina. Não mudou\nem mais de 100 milhões de anos.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: During the spawning season, countless\nLuvdisc congregate at coral reefs,\nturning the waters pink.
entries.portuguese: Na época da desova, inúmeros\nLuvdisc se reúnem nos recifes,\ndeixando as águas rosadas.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: It longingly hopes for wings to grow\nso it can fly. It practices by leaping\noff cliffs every day.
entries.portuguese: Sonha que suas asas cresçam\npara poder voar. Todos os dias,\ntreina saltando de penhascos.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce\noff. The armor is too tough, however,\nmaking it heavy and somewhat sluggish.
entries.portuguese: Sua couraça repele ataques.\nMas ela é tão resistente que\no deixa pesado e meio lento.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: As a result of its long-held dream of\nflying, its cellular structure changed,\nand wings grew out.
entries.portuguese: De tanto sonhar em voar,\nsuas células se modificaram\ne suas asas cresceram.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: It uses magnetic waves to converse\nwith its kind. All the cells in its body\nare magnetic.
entries.portuguese: Usa ondas magnéticas para\nconversar com seus semelhantes.\nTodas as suas células são ímãs.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: When two Beldum fuse together, a\nmagnetic nervous system places their\nbrains in union.
entries.portuguese: Quando dois Beldum se fundem,\num sistema nervoso magnético\nconecta os seus cérebros.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: With four linked brains, it's more\nintelligent than a supercomputer.\nIt uses calculations to analyze foes.
entries.portuguese: Seus quatro cérebros unidos\nsuperam um supercomputador.\nAnalisa inimigos com cálculos.
entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: It is entirely composed of rocks with no\nsign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery\neven to modern scientists.

entries.reason: Texte vivant ; table Pokédex.

entries.english: It is said to have slept in a glacier\nfor thousands of years. Its body\ncan't be melted, even by magma.
